actions.action: Tap a frond over white paper to check for moving pests
Inspect leaf undersides and stem joints with zoom or magnifier for webbing or thrips
Isolate the plant from other plants
Shower fronds, including undersides, with lukewarm water
Spray insecticidal soap or neem oil on all surfaces every 5-7 days for about 3 weeks
Group plants together to raise humidity
Check that the top inch of soil is dry before watering
Share a closer photo of the undersides or moving specks

reason: The answer offers spider mites only as one of two possibilities alongside thrips, but its main treatment of rinsing plus repeated insecticidal spraying matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
